title: Signal
description: A discrete, storable, replayable musical signal extracted from a singing segment. Owned by Person C (Task 3). Breaking changes require a version bump and a heads-up to Person A and Person B before merging.

room_id.description: Room/session this signal was captured in.

role.description: The participant's mode-specific role at capture time (e.g. teacher/student, performer/lead/listener, peer). Populated by Task 1's room/role data; null if unknown/not applicable.

mode.description: The room's mode at capture time.

start_time.description: Start timestamp in milliseconds since epoch (or room-relative ms, must be consistent within a room).

end_time.description: End timestamp, same clock basis as start_time. Must be >= start_time.

audio_ref.description: Reference to the stored audio blob (e.g. a storage-relative path or URI). Not the raw bytes themselves.

audio_format.description: Encoding of the blob at audio_ref. Lossless only — downstream cleaning/note-conversion tasks are sensitive to compression artifacts.

metadata.description: Free-form extension point. Add new fields here rather than changing existing top-level fields.

detected_confidence.description: Task 2 singing-detection confidence that produced this Signal's boundaries.

cleaned.description: Set true by Task 7 once this Signal has been through noise-cleaning.
